title: Treesa-Gayatri Secure Historic World Championships Medal
indian_angle: This marks India's first women's doubles medal at the World Championships in 15 years, continuing the nation's proud podium streak.
summary: The unseeded duo of Treesa Jolly and Gayatri Gopichand stunned World No. 4 Jia and Zhang in the quarterfinals, assuring India of at least one medal at the BWF World Championships.

title: Satwik-Chirag Exit World Championships in Quarterfinals
indian_angle: India's top men's doubles pair, Satwiksairaj Rankireddy and Chirag Shetty, bowed out after a quarterfinal loss to a Chinese duo.
summary: Satwik and Chirag lost to China's Chang and Liang 21-18, 21-9 in the BWF World Championships quarter-finals, amid fitness concerns.

title: Lakshya Sen Suffers Shock Exit at World Championships
indian_angle: Indian singles hopeful Lakshya Sen was unexpectedly defeated by American teenager Garret Tan, ending his World Championships campaign.
summary: India's Lakshya Sen exited the BWF World Championships after a tough match against American Garret Tan, marking a surprise early departure.

title: BAI Successfully Hosts World Championships After 17 Years
indian_angle: The Badminton Association of India successfully hosted the BWF World Championships in India, enhancing facilities based on past feedback.
summary: After 17 years, the Badminton Association of India (BAI) successfully hosted the BWF World Championships, improving facilities following lessons from the India Open.

title: Coach Sumeeth Reddy Reveals Treesa-Gayatri's Success Secrets
indian_angle: Coach Sumeeth Reddy shares insights into the 'ice, fire and a fine line' strategy behind Treesa-Gayatri's impressive unseeded run at the World Championships.
summary: Sumeeth Reddy, coach of Treesa Jolly and Gayatri Gopichand, discusses the mental fortitude and strategy that propelled the unseeded Indian women's doubles pair to a World Championships medal.

title: India Announces Junior Team Coaching Camp for Asia Championships

summary: The Indian team coaching camp for the Badminton Asia U17 & U15 Junior Championships 2026 is being held at the National Center of Excellence in Guwahati.
